column1: # config/c_units.tsv -- C units cut by tools/splat_gen.py (T6): one splat `c` subsegment per row, [start, next existing cut); start = a game-code function start (outside every lib-object of config/boundaries.tsv). src/<alias>/<unit>.c. end (optional, T3): exclusive closing cut, empty = next cut; rows written by tools/carve.py. rodata (optional 6th, T27): comma list of config/boundaries.tsv jtbl starts (0x%08x) owned by the unit (one contiguous run), emitted as `.rodata` subsegments named <unit>; written by tools/carve.py --rodata.
